news.headline:
Avro India confirmed nil deviation in utilizing funds raised via preferential warrant issues for the quarter ended September 2026.

The statement of nil deviation was duly reviewed by the company's Audit Committee pursuant to SEBI listing regulations.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
RBI approved appointing Satbir Singh as Additional Executive Director of Regal Entertainment & Consultants effective November 16, 2026.

The appointment is subject to shareholder approval for a term extending up to April 4, 2028.

Source: BSE
